description: This file contains a portable Oracle OCI8 driver implementation for ADOdb, including a specialized class for the oci8po driver variant, custom metadata SQL queries, parameter handling, and recordset management tailored for Oracle's oci8po extension.

classes.name: ADODB_oci8po
classes.description: Custom driver class for the oci8po driver, extending ADODB_oci8, with specific SQL queries and parameter binding behavior for Oracle oci8po extension.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci8po
classes.description: Recordset class for oci8po driver, extending ADORecordset_oci8, with special handling for field names and fetching data.

methods.name: ADODB_oci8po
methods.description: Constructor for the oci8po driver class, setting internal flags.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Returns '?' as the placeholder for parameters in SQL statements.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Converts '?' placeholders in SQL to Oracle style ':0', ':1', etc.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Handles query parameter substitution, replacing '?' with named bind variable syntax.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Fetches field value by column name, supporting case-insensitive access.

methods.name: _FetchField
methods.description: Fetches metadata for a field, using Oracle OCI8 functions, converting field names to lowercase.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances the recordset to the next row, fetching data from Oracle OCI8 resource.

methods.name: GetArrayLimit
methods.description: Fetches a limited number of rows with optional offset, optimized for Oracle OCI8.

methods.name: _updatefields
methods.description: Updates internal fields array with lowercase keys, converting case according to settings.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row of data from the Oracle resource and processes field case.
